Market Close Report: NASDAQ Composite index closes at 7,411.16 down -3.90 points January 25, 2018, 04:45:11 PM EDT By NASDAQ.com News Shutterstock photo 
Thursday's session closes with the NASDAQ Composite Index at 7,411.16. The total shares traded for the NASDAQ was over 2.03 billion. Declining stocks led advancers by 1.06 to 1 ratio. There were 1440 advancers and 1530 decliners for the day. On the NASDAQ Stock Exchange 86 stocks reached a 52 week high and 13 those reaching lows totaled. The most active, advancers, decliners, unusual volume and most active by dollar volume can be monitored intraday on the Most Active Stocks page. 
The NASDAQ 100 index closed down -.04% for the day; a total of -3.05 points. The current value is 6,916.3. Xilinx, Inc. ( XLNX ) had the largest percent change down (-5.09%) while Netflix, Inc. ( NFLX ) had the largest percent change gain rising 3.21%. The Dow Jones index closed up .54% for the day; a total of 140.67 points. The current value is 26,392.79. Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) had the largest percent change down (-1.79%) while Boeing Company (The) ( BA ) had the largest percent change gain rising 2.52%. NASDAQ Market Wrap As of 1/25/2018 4:44:00 PM BILLIONS OF
